ammonia.reason: Low NH3 from deamination by smear Brevibacterium / Debaryomyces in 3-month rind wash.

animal_barnyard.reason: Moderate p-cresol and branched fatty acids from smear Coryneform tyrosine/catabolism and brine wash.

bitter.reason: Low hydrophobic peptides from rennet + Lactobacillus proteolysis, balanced by brine and raw-milk peptidases.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation so no C7-C11 2-alkanone blue ketone pathway.

browning.reason: Moderate Maillard lactose-protein + fat browning in classic fondue melter, lower than Gruyere.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl/acetoin from citrate-positive Lactococcus lactis citrate metabolism in raw-milk starter.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Butanoic/hexanoic acids from starter esterase + mild lipolysis during 3.5-month ripening.

creaminess.reason: High 30% fat, 45% moisture and smear proteolysis giving smooth fondue paste.

crumbliness.reason: Pressed elastic semi-hard paste at pH 5.6 retains calcium phosphate, low fracture.

firmness.reason: Semi-hard pressed curd cooked ~40C, 45% moisture gives sliceable but supple body.

floral_honey.reason: Low phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol from phenylalanine Strecker by starter/smear flora.

fruity.reason: Ethyl butanoate/hexanoate from ethanol + free fatty acid esterification by lactic flora.

goaty.reason: Cow milk low in caproic/caprylic goat acids, no goat-specific branched lipolysis.

malty_nutty.reason: 2-/3-methylbutanal and benzaldehyde from leucine/isoleucine Strecker during Alpine ripening.

melt.reason: pH 5.6 intact casein + 45% moisture flows fully, classic moitie-moitie fondue cheese.

mushroom_earthy.reason: Trace 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one from linoleic acid lipoxygenase on smear rind.

oil_off.reason: 30% fat semi-hard releases moderate free oil on heating, less than hard grana.

smoky.reason: No smoking step and no guaiacol/phenol wood-smoke deposition.

sour_vinegar.reason: Low acetic acid from heterofermentative starter, mild acidity at pH 5.4-5.9.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata hot-water kneading, rennet gel only slightly extensible when melted.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Low methanethiol/dimethyl sulfide/methional from methionine catabolism by Brevibacterium linens.

sweet.reason: Residual sweet perception from diacetyl, glycerol and low salt despite lactose depletion.

umami.reason: Moderate glutamate and savory peptides from 3.5-month Lactobacillus proteolysis.
